description: This file defines an Android activity class 'DeepLinkHelpActivity' used for displaying instructions related to deep links for preview purposes. It sets up a simple UI with a TextView containing instructions, styled with theme colors and padding.

classes.name: DeepLinkHelpActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays instructions for launching deep links, primarily for preview purposes. It customizes the UI in its onCreate method.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the AppCompatActivity onCreate method to set up the activity's UI by applying a theme and displaying a TextView with help instructions.
